titleArabic: Yeh Jo Halka Halka Suroor Hai
titleEnglish: Yeh Jo Halka Halka Suroor Hai — Abdul Hameed Adam / Nusrat Fateh Ali Khan
poet: Abdul Hameed Adam / Nusrat Fateh Ali Khan

verses.ar:
Yeh jo halka halka suroor hai
Yeh teri nazar ka kusoor hai
Ke sharaab peena sikha diya
verses.en:
This gentle, sweet intoxication
Is the fault of your eyes
That taught me how to drink (lose myself in devotion)

verses.ar:
Saaqi ki har nigaah pe bal kha ke pee gaya
Lehron se khelta hua lehra ke pee gaya
verses.en:
In awe of every glance of the cup-bearer, I drank deeply
Playing with the waves, swaying, I drank

verses.ar:
Ae rehmat-e-tamaam, meri har khata muaaf
Mein inteha-e-shoq mein ghabra ke pee gaya
verses.en:
O mercy complete, forgive my every sin
In the height of my yearning, I drank in agitation

verses.ar:
Peeta baghair izn, yeh kab thi meri majaal
Dar-parda chashm-e-yaar ki shah paa ke pee gaya
verses.en:
Drinking without permission — when was this ever within my power?
I drank having found the hidden signal in the beloved's glance

verses.ar:
Zahid, yeh meri shokhi-e-rindana dekhna
Rehmat ko baaton baaton mein behla ke pee gaya
Tauba ko torh taarh thara ke pee gaya
verses.en:
O ascetic, witness my brazen, wandering ways
I charmed mercy itself with words, and drank
I broke my repentance, cast it aside, and drank

verses.ar:
Udi udi ghataye aati hain
Mutribon ki nawaen aati hain
Kis ke gaisu khule hain saawan mein
Mehki mehki hawaen aati hain
Aao sehn-e-chaman mein raqs karein
Saaz le kar ghataye aati hain
verses.en:
The clouds come drifting, drifting in
The melodies of the musicians come floating
Whose tresses have come undone in the monsoon?
The fragrant breezes are coming
Come, let us dance in the garden's courtyard
The clouds come carrying music with them

verses.ar:
Dekh kar unki akhriyon ko, Adam
Maikadon ko hayaen aati hain
verses.en:
Seeing the corners of their eyes, O Adam
Even the taverns are struck with awe

verses.ar:
Paas rehta hai, door rehta hai
Koi dil mein zaroor rehta hai
Jab se dekha hai unki aankhon ko
Halka halka suroor rehta hai
verses.en:
Near yet far, someone surely dwells within the heart
Ever since I saw their eyes
A gentle, sweet intoxication remains

verses.ar:
Aese rehte hain woh mere dil mein
Jaise zulmat mein noor rehta hai
Ab Adam ka yeh haal hai har waqt
Mast rehta hai, choor rehta hai
verses.en:
They dwell in my heart just so
As light dwells within darkness
Such is Adam's condition at every moment
He remains intoxicated, he remains absorbed

verses.ar:
Yeh jo halka halka suroor hai
Yeh teri nazar ka kusoor hai
Ke sharaab peena sikha diya
Tere pyaar ne, teri chaah ne
Teri behki behki nigaah ne
Mujhe ek sharaabi bana diya
verses.en:
This gentle, sweet intoxication
Is the fault of your eyes
That taught me how to drink
Your love and your longing
Your swaying, intoxicating glances
Have made me into a drunkard

verses.ar:
Sharaab kaisi, khumaar kaisa
Yeh sab tumhaari nawazishen hain
Pilaayi hai kis nazar se tu ne
Ke mujhko apni khabar nahi hai
verses.en:
What wine, what intoxication —
All of this is your grace and favour
With what a glance you made me drink
That I have lost all awareness of myself

verses.ar:
Saara jahaan mast
Jahaan ka nizaam mast
Din mast, raat mast
Sahar mast, shaam mast
Khum mast, sheesha mast
Sabu mast, jaam mast
Hai teri chashm-e-mast se har khaas-o-aam mast
verses.en:
The entire world is intoxicated
The order of the world is intoxicated
Day intoxicated, night intoxicated
Dawn intoxicated, dusk intoxicated
The cask intoxicated, the glass intoxicated
The vessel intoxicated, the cup intoxicated
Through your intoxicated eyes, every person great and common is drunk

verses.ar:
Yoon to saaqi har tarah ki tere maikhaane mein hai
Woh bhi thori si jo inn aankhon ke paimaane mein hai
Sab samajhta hoon teri ishvaagari, ae saaqi
Kaam karti hai nazar, naam hai paimaane ka
verses.en:
Every kind of wine is in your tavern, O cup-bearer
Including a little of what lives within the vessel of these eyes
I understand all your coquetry, O cup-bearer
It is the glance that does the work — the cup is only its name

verses.ar:
Tera pyaar hai meri zindagi
Bas meri zindagi tera pyaar hai
Na namaaz aati hai mujhko na wuzu aata hai
Sajda kar leta hoon jab saamne tu aata hai
verses.en:
Your love is my life
My life is nothing but your love
I know neither prayer nor ablution
Yet I prostrate whenever you appear before me

verses.ar:
Mein azal se banda-e-ishq hoon
Mujhe zohd-o-kufr ka gham nahi
Mere sar ko dar tera mil gaya
Mujhe ab talaash-e-Haram nahi
Meri bandagi, hai woh bandagi
Jo muqeed-e-dair-o-Haram nahi
Mera ek nazar tumhein dekhna
Ba Khuda namaaz se kam nahi
verses.en:
From eternity I have been a servant of love
I am troubled neither by piety nor by disbelief
My head has found your threshold
I no longer search for the Haram
My devotion is that devotion
Which is not bound by temple or mosque
One single glance at you —
By God, it is no less than prayer

verses.ar:
Teri yaad hai meri bandagi
Jo teri khushi, woh meri khushi
Yeh mere junoon ka hai mojza
Jahan apne sar ko jhuka diya
Wahan mein ne Kaaba bana diya
verses.en:
Your remembrance is my worship
What pleases you pleases me
This is the miracle of my devotion —
Wherever I bowed my head
There I made my Kaaba

verses.ar:
Mere baad kis ko sataao ge
Mein ne un ke saamne awwal to khanjar rakh diya
Phir kaleja rakh diya, dil rakh diya, sar rakh diya
Aur arz kiya mere baad kis ko sataao ge
Mujhe kis tarah se mitaao ge
Kahan ja ke teer chalaao ge
Meri doosti ki balaayen lo
Mujhe haath utha ke duaein do
Tumhein ek kaatil bana diya
verses.en:
After me, whom will you torment?
First I placed a dagger before them
Then I placed my chest, my heart, my head
And said: after me, whom will you torment?
How will you erase me?
Where will you go to fire your arrows?
Take away the misfortunes of my friendship
Raise your hands and pray for me
You have made a murderer of yourself
